regions.explanation: From 28.49s to 30.69s (“and, at the solicitation”), loudness relative to the speaker's own level fell 7.1 dB below the reference, bottoming out 8.9 dB down; that is 1.4× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. The loudness falls away across the phrase, so its final words - often the payoff - drop toward the noise floor of the room. Fix: Support the breath through the end of the phrase; the last words need the same energy as the first.

regions.text: of peace in the Pacific. Indeed, one
regions.explanation: From 42.04s to 47.12s (“of peace in the Pacific. Indeed, one”), the share of energy above 2 kHz dropped to 3.1% from 28.5% (-89%); that is 6.4× the reference speaker's natural word-to-word variation. Energy above 2 kHz carries consonant bursts and fricatives (t, k, s, f); losing it blurs word boundaries and makes the speech sound muffled even at normal volume. Fix: Open the mouth more and finish final consonants crisply.
